bounds.quantity: dissipation of a protocol in the registered class R_PROTO implementing F_AND, in units of k_B T ln 2
bounds.range_derivation: The bounded quantity is the dissipation of a protocol of the registered class R_PROTO, in units of k_B T ln 2.  R_PROTO is defined as the class of protocols that act only on the registered logical register D and reset it with the registered reset primitive.  By that definition the dissipation is 0 when the protocol resets nothing, which fixes range_lo = 0, and is at most the full reset of the register, log2|D| = 2, which fixes range_hi. prospective_predictions.caveat: the registered freeze phrases the classic witness as K_U ranging from a small constant to m bits.  On the frozen machine at string length 6 and cap 14 that numeric phrasing is not attainable: the emit instructions cost 2 bits each and HALT 2, so the ceiling is pinned at 14 and the floor cannot be small. What is witnessed, and all that is claimed, is that one maximal Shannon entropy value of 6 bits coexists with members of 3 distinct K_U values spanning 11 to 14.
prospective_predictions.claim: all twelve ordered pairs of the four quantities are witnessed non-functionally dependent on the registered roster; in particular a uniform distribution over 2**m strings has maximal exact H_shannon while its members have K_U ranging from a small registered constant to m bits
the resource registry classifies every resource named by this Section AE tranche, and the count of PHYSICAL_ENERGETIC resources instantiated by the tranche is exactly 0

prospective_predictions.caveat: B_LANDAUER__F_BIJECTION has bound value 0 against a definitional floor of 0.  It is reported as vacuous and as an UNFALSIFIED_BOUND, and it closes nothing; a non-negative quantity cannot fall below 0.
prospective_predictions.claim: for every registered map the Landauer statement is emitted as a lower-bound record with an exact integer erased-bit coefficient, a vacuity classification, an attained_by witness and a violated_by witness from an explicitly relaxed class
DEV_LOW_OVERHEAD and DEV_HIGH_OVERHEAD have the SAME exact integer erased-bit count and DIFFERENT registered total cost, so the erasure bound provably fails to determine total cost
registered_physical_systems is exactly 0, no nonequilibrium term appears in any claim of the package, the no-alarm case holds on the clean roster and the planted nonequilibrium fixture is flagged

F_BIJECTION has erased-bit count exactly 0 and Landauer lower bound exactly 0 while its registered device cost is strictly positive, so logical irreversibility and physical dissipation are not the same quantity

census_summary.derived_meaning: H_shannon and S_stat are linked by the registered definitional relation H_shannon <= log2 W, since W is the size of the support of P; a derived witness exhibits the slack in that relation.  The other ten pairs have no registered definitional relation at all.
